verdict.rationale: Ramp documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp for connecting assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, with admin role controls, a demo server, and two more MCP servers for developer docs and Ramp Data. A live probe confirms the server is OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec and publishes granular read/write scopes. Missing for 10: bill approvals are not yet available via MCP, and there is no independent community or user report of hands-on MCP use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Ramp MCP lets you securely connect Ramp with AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Notion.
Ramp ships three MCP servers, each scoped to a different audience
Ramp MCP allows you to securely connect Ramp with AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, so you can query Ramp data and take actions with natural language.
